featured_reviews.name: Mansi Goyal
featured_reviews.review_text:
My postnatal experience with Dr. Leena ,

Attended postnatal live sessions by Dr. Leena which really gave me the kickstart and motivation I needed to begin my fitness journey after delivery.

I truly appreciate her dedication, patience, and consistent support throughout the program. She explained the exercises clearly, ensured that movements were done safely, and created a comfortable environment for learning and recovery. Her encouragement helped me slowly rebuild confidence in my body and stay motivated.

The recorded sessions were also helpful in maintaining continuity and practicing at my own pace. Overall, it has been a positive and beneficial experience for my postnatal recovery.It would be great if 4 recorded sessions in second month could be converted to 4 live sessions with video to practice so we remain focused toward continuing our exercises ☺️ Otherwise, the sessions were very well conducted and supportive. Would recommend her completely to start your fitness journey after delivery .

featured_reviews.name: khushbu gawde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Leena is absolutely wonderful. I started seeing her for post C-section recovery and I’m so glad I did. From day one she was patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. She took time to understand my pain points, explained why my core and pelvic floor felt the way they did, and built a plan that actually worked for my body and schedule as a new mom.

Her sessions helped me reduce scar sensitivity, improve posture, ease back pain, and regain core strength without pushing too hard too fast. She’s excellent at explaining the ‘why’ behind each exercise, which made me feel confident doing them at home too.

If you’re a new mom struggling post C-section, I can’t recommend Dr. Leena enough. She helped me feel strong and like myself again. Thank you, Dr. Leena!

featured_reviews.name: Karishma Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of attending Dr. Leena Jain's prenatal classes during my pregnancy, and I cannot recommend her highly enough. From the very first session, it was clear that she is not only incredibly experienced but also deeply passionate about supporting expectant mothers.
One of the standout features of her classes was the personalized attention she provided. She made a consistent effort to follow up with me, which made me feel valued and supported throughout my journey. Her ability to check in and offer encouragement was invaluable, especially during those moments of uncertainty that can come with pregnancy.
Her approach to promoting normal delivery was both motivating and empowering. She equipped me with the knowledge and techniques I needed to remain calm and confident as I approached my delivery date.
Talking to her was always a calming experience. Her warm demeanor and genuine interest in my well-being created an environment where I felt safe to ask questions and express my concerns. She has a unique ability to instill confidence, making the entire experience more enjoyable and less daunting.
Her expertise, supportive nature, and motivational guidance made all the difference. I am grateful for the knowledge I gained and the encouragement I received. If you are looking for a prenatal class that combines professionalism with a personal touch, look no further than Dr. Leena Jain!

featured_reviews.name: Anusha Nandigam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined the prenatal fitness sessions by Dr. Leena, and I can’t recommend them enough! 🌸

What I love most is how the exercises are customized based on your specific pains or challenges since every pregnancy is different, this personal approach makes a big difference. They guide you through the right stretches to help reduce cramps and ease discomfort.

The fact that it’s online is another huge plus — you can join from anywhere! My doctor had advised me not to do any unsupervised yoga or exercise, so this setup was perfect.

The breathing exercises are also amazing for relaxation and mental peace. And honestly, Dr. Leena’s positive energy and warm smile make every session so engaging and fun, you actually look forward to working out!

For all moms-to-be who are dealing with pain or simply want to stay active and healthy during pregnancy, these sessions truly help you feel better and more confident. 💕
